yrune.description: The Yield Bearing RUNE Index (yRUNE) is a auto-rebalancing index that tracks the performance of RUNE and TCY, while generating yield from TCY staking.

ytcy.description: Liquid Staked TCY (yTCY) is an auto-rebalancing index designed to track the performance of both RUNE and TCY, with a strategic overweight on TCY to maximize yield potential.

rji.description: The Rujira Index (RJI) is a fixed unit asset index that tracks the performance of tokens on the Rujira App Layer. RJI does not auto-rebalance, therefore by design continously overweighting the top performers and underweighting the under-performers.
